answer: Proof of Useful Stake mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring agents to commit computational capital to a delta of network tasks. By anchoring reputation to a crystal clear audit trail of verifiable work, the system forces an adversary to expend significant energy, akin to the impact of a comet striking a fortified target. This economic barrier makes scaling fake identities prohibitively expensive, ensuring that influence remains tied to resource allocation rather than mere software replication.
